articles.headline: Popovic comfortable with Socceroos penalty shootout choices at World Cup
articles.description: Socceroos coach Tony Popovic isn't second-guessing the shootout that saw his side eliminated from the FIFA World Cup, saying that he would have made the same choices had the two sides come back the next day.
